notes:
Thank you for reviewing Letzte Runde. The app is now available in English (follows the device language) and German.

IN-APP PURCHASES (optional tips, consumable, unlock nothing)
"One Spezi", "Daily Ration of Spezi", "Crate of Spezi".
Where to find them: launch the app and scroll to the very bottom of the start screen. Tap "Buy me a Spezi". A sheet opens with the three tips and their prices; tap one to buy with the sandbox account.
Note on the previous rejections: the app was only available in Germany, so the review storefront (USA) could not load the products. The app is now available in all territories.

WHAT IT IS
A cooperative card game based on Texas Hold'em hand rankings: players do not compete, they try together to rank their hands from weakest to strongest using numbered chips, without talking about their cards. No betting, no real money, no ads.

HOW TO REVIEW (no account needed)
- Singleplayer: on the start screen tap "Play" next to "Singleplayer". You play against bots; this works fully offline (airplane mode). Take a chip, tap "Ready", repeat for 4 rounds, then see the result.
- Multiplayer online: enter a name (no account required), tap "Create room", then "Add bot" twice and "Deal" to play a room with bots. To test with a second device, share the invite link (browser or app).
- Local network without internet: tap "Venue" > "Host on Wi-Fi". The app runs its own game server on the device; other devices join via QR code (camera permission is only used to scan this code) or the local network search (local network permission).
- Game logic updates: the app can download signed game-logic bundles (scoring, bots) from our server, so minor rule fixes don't need a store release. The app always works without them.

NOT A WEB WRAPPER
The complete game (rules engine, bots, encrypted dealing) is bundled and runs on the device. The app embeds a Node.js runtime that hosts games for nearby devices without internet, uses native haptics, Bonjour discovery, QR scanning and native sign-in sheets. The online server is only used for internet multiplayer and optional accounts.

USER-GENERATED CONTENT (Guideline 1.2)
Rooms have a text chat and user-chosen names. Safeguards:
- Filter: chat messages, player names and room names pass a server-side word filter for slurs and profanity.
- Report: tap "⋯" next to any player > "Report" (reason buttons). Reports reach the operator with the room's recent chat; the operator is notified immediately and reviews them within 24 hours, and can close rooms or delete accounts.
- Block: in the same menu, "Mute" hides that player's chat, bubbles and reactions on this device permanently.
- The room host can remove players (✕). Rooms can be private (only with code or link).
- Contact: kontakt@simongutjahr.de

ACCOUNTS
Optional (name + password, no e-mail). Accounts can be deleted in the app: "Account & statistics" > "⚙️ Account" > "Delete account permanently".

ENCRYPTION
Uses only standard encryption (HTTPS/TLS, Web Crypto ECDH + AES-GCM for fair card dealing) provided by the OS/standard libraries; ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption = NO.

Source code: https://github.com/sgitaize/letzte-runde
